params.description: Enterobacteriaceae con regulones curados en RegPrecise (gtdb_family = 'Enterobacteriaceae' AND selection IN ('forced','regprecise_source'))

queries.genomes: SELECT genome_id, accession, ncbi_organism, gtdb_domain, gtdb_phylum, gtdb_class, gtdb_order, gtdb_family, gtdb_genus, gtdb_species, completeness, contamination, assembly_level, selection FROM genomes
queries.motifs: SELECT motif_id, motif_key, source, tf_name, tf_family, source_taxon, length FROM motifs
queries.regprecise_genome_map: SELECT genome_name, accession, source, resolved_name, assembly_level FROM regprecise_genome_map
queries.regprecise_regulogs: SELECT DISTINCT cr.regulog_id, rm.accession FROM curated_regulons cr JOIN regprecise_genome_map rm ON cr.genome_name = rm.genome_name WHERE rm.accession IS NOT NULL
queries.curated_regulons: SELECT rm.accession, cr.regulog_id, cr.tf_name, cr.locus_tag, cr.gene_name FROM curated_regulons cr JOIN regprecise_genome_map rm ON cr.genome_name = rm.genome_name WHERE rm.accession IN :accs
queries.genes: SELECT gene_id, genome_id, locus_tag, contig, start_pos, end_pos, strand, protein_id, gene_name, biotype, operon_id, operon_role FROM genes WHERE genome_id IN :ids
queries.fimo_hits: SELECT genome_id, gene_id, motif_id, neg_log10_p FROM fimo_hits WHERE genome_id IN :ids AND neg_log10_p >= :min_p
queries.gene_index: SELECT g.genome_id, g.gene_name, ann.preferred_name, ann.og FROM genes g LEFT JOIN annotations ann ON ann.gene_id = g.gene_id WHERE g.genome_id IN :ids AND g.protein_id IS NOT NULL
